jobs.title: Administrative Business Partner, Office of the CEO
jobs.description: <h2 id="who-we-are">Who we are</h2> <h3 id="about-stripe">About Stripe</h3> <p>Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.</p> <h3 id="about-the-team">About the team</h3> <p>The administrative business partner team works with Stripe's leaders to support their day-to-day administrative needs, while also contributing to projects that help drive the company's strategic priorities.</p> <h2 id="what-youll-do">What you'll do</h2> <p>Stripe is seeking an eager and poised individual with a high attention to detail, strong communication skills, and professional drive to support the Office of the CEO. This role reports directly to the Administrative Business Partner (ABP) to the CEO and is responsible for a wide range of tasks. A successful candidate has a "no task too big, no task too small" mindset, sound judgment, and the ability to partner with leaders and individuals across the organization. Additionally, this individual has unwavering discretion, proven experience operating in ambiguous environments, and resilience.</p> <p>The CEO is based out of our South San Francisco HQ, so we're looking for someone to be in-office at least 3 days per week.</p> <h3 id="responsibilities">Responsibilities</h3> <ul> <li>Offer administrative support to our CEO by partnering with their ABP, Family Home Office (FHO), and security team to enable seamless movements for a complex calendar</li> <li>Support extensive research and logistics for unique and high-caliber offsite events</li> <li>Travel to offices and support executive onsites</li> <li>Track, manage, and reconcile expenses monthly</li> <li>Liaise with external contacts for a high volume of external speaking engagements, mapping out all aspects of the engagement (e.g. travel, security access, briefing materials, etc.)</li> <li>Manage end-to-end complex travel including planning, presenting various creative options in advance of domestic and international trips</li> <li>Identify opportunities to establish new—and improve existing—administrative systems and processes.
